title: DarkMusic 1.4.9 Release
changelog:
• Persistent Quick Settings Media Player under notification center (stays active even when app is closed)
• Completely overhauled Share Lyrics UI: full scrollable lyrics list with pinned bottom action bar
• True original studio sound in lyrics video (non-robotic, sample-accurate, natural duration for full lines)
• Bold & enlarged lyrics typography (58f bold), larger album art thumbnail, and official DarkMusic promotional banner
